To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) the Serra da prata arc is an early stage of juvenile magmatic arc development in the Ribeiras belt (ii) the Serra Da prata arc is associated with the Italva Group (iii) the Serra de Prata arc is older than the Rio Negro arc (iv) the Rio Negro arc is associated with a back-arc basin.
the Ribeira Belt is the product of the progressive amalgamation between several juvenile terranes against the Eastern margin of the Sao Fransciso craton between 620 and 560 Ma.
the Serra da Bolivia magmatic arc is a continental arc that evolved from 590 to 570 Ma and that is associated with the amalgamation of the Sao Francisco craton to the western margin of Gondwana.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the tectonic evolution of an early stage of the Ribeir belt.
the evolution of a primitive arc stage in the Ribeirabelt, which is interpreted as an intra-oceanic magmatic arc, followed by more evolved arc stages, which are interpreted as transitional arc.
the evolution of the juvenile Tonian magmatic arc, the Serra da Bolivia arc and the evolution of the Rio Negro arc, in the Ribeir belt of SE Brazil, in a Western Gondwanan context.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the juvenile arc of Serra da Prate is a part of a juvenile arc that developed along the margin of the Sao Fransisco Craton, and was involved in the accretion of Western Gondwanna.
the Ribeira Belt is a complex collage of several juvenile and more mature magmatic arcs and their respective accretionary terranes.
the Ribeira Belt is a collage of several juvenile and more mature arc segments, with the juvenile arc being the first one to be amalgamated with the eastern margin of Western Gondwane.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Serra da Bolivia, Serra da Prate, Rio Negro, Goias and Sao Gabriel arcs were developed in a similar setting, with the same tectonic evolution, but at different times.
the Ribeira and other Neoproterozoico belts of Western Gondwane are the result of the amalgamation of juvenile arcs, juvenile micro-continents and older continental blocks.
the Serra da Bolivia, Serra da Pratta and Rio Negro arcs were developed in an intra-oceanic setting, whereas the Serra da Boliva and Rio Doce arcs were developed in a continental setting.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the Tonian arc stages are older than previously thought and that the Rio Negro Arc is a more evolved continental arc, with an age of ca. 790 Ma.
the Serra da Bolivia arc was not the only arc in the region during the Neoproterozic.
the juvenile arc stage of the Ribeir belt was developed in a more distal location than the later continental arcs, and the arc generation was more continuous than previously proposed.
